categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Jinfu Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two sectors: consumer electronics and new energy. Its main products include LCD display modules and complete sets, consumer electronic components, testing fixtures and automation equipment, lithium battery components, automotive parts, petroleum resin products, and power equipment maintenance and installation engineering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as optical design, mold development, injection molding, and structural design for LCD modules. It integrates multi-disciplinary technologies including precision machinery, servo control, machine vision, and software for intelligent testing equipment. In new energy, it leverages patented aerogel packaging technologies and advanced molding processes for thermal insulation products, and develops graphene-based heating solutions for automotive applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international consumer electronics firms such as TCL Huaxing, Hikvision, LGD, Hisense, Luxshare Precision, and Amazon, as well as new energy and automotive industry leaders like CATL, Minth Group, and Geely. The company serves markets in digital displays, smart devices, lithium batteries, and automotive components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D bases in the Yangtze River Delta (Shanghai, Suzhou, Taizhou), Pearl River Delta (Shenzhen, Dongguan, Changsha), Bohai Rim (Weihai), and Haixi Economic Zone (Xiamen). It also has international operations including a manufacturing base in Bac Ninh, Vietnam, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Jinfu Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electronic components, modules, and battery parts, as well as providing testing and automation solutions. It also engages in automotive parts production and power equipment services, positioning itself as a comprehensive supplier integrating R&D and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a dual-driven strategy focusing on consumer electronics and new energy sectors, emphasizing innovation in thermal management materials, high-end adhesives, and electrochemical materials. It invests in R&D for intelligent testing fixtures, flexible PCB testing, VR optical testing, graphene-based thermal solutions, and new battery materials. The company also prioritizes digital transformation, automation, and talent development to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including LCD modules, consumer electronic components, testing equipment, lithium battery parts, and automotive components. The company also earns income from engineering services and government subsidies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major players in the consumer electronics and new energy sectors, including TCL Huaxing, Hikvision, CATL, and Minth Group. It positions itself as a technology-driven, integrated manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities and diversified product lines, aiming to enhance market share through innovation and strategic customer partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.8 billion, a 3.13% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 267 million. Despite losses, the company is expanding its new energy business with a 25.73% revenue growth in that segment. It has a total asset base of over RMB 3.2 billion and is actively investing in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Jinfu Technology emphasizes integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, advanced production technologies, and customized intelligent testing solutions. Its products offer high reliability, precision, and innovation, particularly in thermal management and graphene-based materials. The company leverages strong customer relationships and a broad product portfolio to provide differentiated, high-value solutions in consumer electronics and new energy markets.
